items.t: Engine dies while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; replace crank sensor or cam phasers, or update software
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $1,410 as typical; cost depends on the cause found.

items.t: Integrated power module (TIPM) failure
items.job: Replace and program integrated power module (TIPM)
items.note: Owners report about $800 to nearly $3,000; CarComplaints lists about $1,220 as typical.

items.t: Passenger side heater blows cold
items.job: Replace heater core (dash removal) and refill coolant
items.note: Owners report about $860 at an independent shop and $1,200-1,700 at dealers.

items.t: Jerky shifting or slipping (2011-2014)
items.job: Software update and relearn, solenoid repair, or transmission replacement
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $1,200 for jerking and about $4,000 for slipping.

items.t: Left cylinder head failure and misfires
items.job: Replace left cylinder head (3.6L)
items.note: May be covered by Chrysler's extended head warranty.

items.t: Oil filter housing leak
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler assembly

items.t: Ticking from worn rocker arms
items.job: Replace rocker arms and lash adjusters, both banks

items.t: Engine stalls while driving (2015-2017)
items.job: Diagnose stalling and repair power distribution connections
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $1,130 as typical; recall work is free.

items.t: Rough, delayed or erratic shifting from the 9-speed automatic
items.job: Transmission software update, relearn or wiring repair
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $750 for related transmission repairs; replacing the transmission costs far more.
